<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 240" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="grad_week" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#EFF6FF" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow_week" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="125%" height="125%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="6" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <rect width="240" height="240" rx="36" fill="url(#grad_week)"/>
  <g filter="url(#shadow_week)">
    
        <circle cx="120" cy="120" r="75" fill="#3B82F6" opacity="0.10"/>
        <circle cx="120" cy="120" r="56" fill="#3B82F6" opacity="0.18"/>
        <text x="120" y="142" font-size="62" font-family="'Segoe UI', Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" fill="#3B82F6" text-anchor="middle">🗓️</text>
      
  </g>
</svg>
